texto: **Fare**: io **feci**, lui **fece**, parrot **fecero** (but your facesti, noi facemmo, voi faceste).
**Essere / Avere**: I went, fu, furono / ebbi, ebbe, ebbero.

In the cultural press, the historical essay and the great Italian literature, the remote passage is the vertebral time. Knowing to identify it and reconstruct its time sequence with respect to causes and consequences is an inescapable requirement of level B2.

intro: Much of the most common verbs in historical texts have a classic alternation in the remote passage called «pretérito fuerte» or symmetrical: the first person singular (io), the third person singular (lui / lei) and the third person plural (parrot) have modified root with terminations -i, -e, -ero (s. feci, fice, fecer; dissi, disse, dissero; presi, prese, presero), while your, noi and voi retain the regular root of the infinitif.
